Unified light output forced.
Raw input report tracing enabled.
Dot-matrix display showcase enabled (default).
=== Maschine Mikro MK3 Reactive Demo ===
(All mappings are fixed for seed 42)

Behavior:
  Button press  -> cycles brightness: off -> mid -> full
  Pad press     -> restores that pad's startup color
  Knob          -> selects the active Dashboard by absolute position
  Logo button   -> toggles Dashboard invert mode
  Touch fader   -> animates touch-strip LEDs
  Dashboard     -> whole display made of non-overlapping Widgets
  Demo pages     -> 8 Dashboards available
